name: Apply Wall Primer (Spray, No Backroll)
intent: Spray PVA primer onto bare drywall, no backroll. Used when builder-grade schedule demands speed over mud-joint compaction — common on production NC. Single coat regardless of QT.
doctrine: Spray-only primer is ~50% faster than spray+backroll because the backroll pass is skipped. Tradeoff: mud joints may flash through without the backroll working primer into the profile — acceptable on builder-grade NC where finish coats will hide any uneven absorption.
